title: 015 拿回属于我的一切016 二十三的智谋
content_zh:
不对劲！
一百个有一万个不对劲！
张泱的怒火来得快，去得也快。
她意识到了什么，停下来回踱步的动作，视线落向那面舆图屏风上面——家园地图中有无数PC在此地建国，玩家想拿回宅基地，在这建造属于玩家自己的世界，就要将这些势力全部铲除收服。这才是家园主线任务！
现在，这也是张泱的任务。
完成任务才能随心所欲建造自己的家园！
而这也是每个人类玩家经历过的。
张泱很快又想起了一些细节。
难怪她经常看到人类观察样本待家园地图，一待就是好久，每天上线下线都在家园捣鼓什么。张泱喊他们去野外打劫玩家抓异兽打丧尸探索副本秘境，他们都婉拒。
张泱那会儿还疑惑家园有这么好玩吗？
好家伙，原来真相在这里。
张泱表面上看着专注，仿佛要将上面的山川走向全部记在心中，脑子里都在走神。
而这一切，全部落入女子的眼中。
低头喝茶时，嘴角翘起意味深长的弧度。
尽管张泱表现相当古怪，试图用装疯卖傻迷惑旁人，但她岂会轻易上当？她也没有骗张泱，屏风上这张舆图确确实实是二十多年前的，如今不适用了，张泱记下也无用。
“见小友专注于此，可是参悟了什么？”
张泱醒过神，抬手指着舆图。
问女子：“这天地可幅员辽阔？”
“旁观四极，俯察地理。川渎浩汗而分流，山岳磊落而罗峙。沧海沆渀而四周，悬圃隆崇而特起。”神秘女子悠悠感慨，“天地之辽阔浩大，岂是你我蝼蚁可窥一二？”
张泱只听到一大段叽里咕噜以及那句“天地辽阔浩大”六个字，颔首表示了赞同。

能不大吗？
这可是价值八十八万八千八百八十八亿联盟币的地契，好东西！张泱内心升起一丝微妙的自豪——有人夸奖她家，作为主人自然开心。只要她做完任务，天地就属于她！
“小友还未回答我的问题。”
看着这幅舆图，她在想什么？
张泱怔了怔，余光瞥向了系统日志上面的文字对话，对方问她有什么参悟。她如实道：“我看舆图便知，我将是这天下之主！”
在她的地盘上建国，PC真是胆肥！
张泱心中盘算如何拿回属于她的一切。
挨个儿屠光PC？
这个办法工程量太大了，PC还会刷新，她砍一辈子也砍不完啊。张泱记得人类观察样本也没耗费多久就在家园养老了，办法肯定不是杀光。再者，家园支线这么大，总要有一些会走动的PC当点缀，添点儿人气。
张泱率先否决这个想法。
最稳妥的办法还是老老实实跑任务了，她打算探一探沈知，尽快触发下一步任务。
唉，沈知真不争气啊！
脑子不好使，建星跟天弁二选一，这家伙都能精确选错方向，发布任务磨磨唧唧。
张泱在心里将沈知嫌弃一遍。
殊不知，她那番话给女子带去多大震撼，后者试图从她脸上找出一点开玩笑的痕迹，然而没有。她那句话掷地有声，态度更是理所当然，似在阐述一件天经地义的事。
神秘女子抚掌：“少年人，后生可畏。”
content_en:
Something's wrong!
One hundred and ten thousand things are wrong!
Zhang Yang's anger went away as quickly as it came.
She realized something, stopped pacing back and forth, and looked at the map screen - in the home map, there were countless PCs establishing their country here. If players want to take back their homestead and build their own world here, they must eradicate and conquer all these forces. This is the main mission of Homeland!
Now, this is also Zhang Yang's task.
Complete tasks to build your own home as you wish!
And this is what every human player has experienced.
Zhang Yang quickly remembered some details.
No wonder she often sees human observation samples staying on the home map for a long time, messing around in their home every day both online and offline. Zhang Yang asked them to go to the wild to rob players, catch strange beasts, fight zombies, and explore the secret realm of the dungeon, but they all declined.
At that time, Zhang Yang was still wondering if his homeland was so fun?
Good guys, it turns out the truth is here.
Zhang Yang looked focused on the surface, as if he wanted to memorize all the directions of the mountains and rivers above, and his mind was wandering.
And all of this fell into the eyes of the woman.
When he lowered his head to drink tea, the corners of his mouth turned up in a meaningful arc.
Although Zhang Yang behaved quite strangely and tried to confuse others by pretending to be crazy and acting stupid, how could she be easily fooled? She did not lie to Zhang Yang. The map on the screen was indeed from more than 20 years ago. It is no longer relevant now, and it is useless for Zhang Yang to write it down.
"I see my little friend focusing on this, but what did he comprehend?"
Zhang Yang woke up and pointed at the map.
Asked the woman: "How vast is this world?"
"Look at the four poles and observe the geography. The rivers are divided by the vastness of the river, and the mountains are flat and straight. The sea is surrounded by the sea, and the hanging gardens are majestic and special." The mysterious woman sighed with emotion, "How can you and I, the ants, get a glimpse of the vastness of the heaven and earth?"
Zhang Yang only heard a long paragraph of chirping and the six words "the world is vast and vast", and nodded in agreement.
Can it be smaller?
This is a land deed worth 888888.8 billion alliance coins, a good thing! A subtle sense of pride arose in Zhang Yang's heart - someone praised her family, and as the owner, she was naturally happy. As long as she completes her mission, the world will belong to her!
"Young friend, you haven't answered my question yet."
Looking at this map, what was she thinking?
Zhang Yang was stunned for a moment. From the corner of her eye, she glanced at the text conversation on the system log. The other party asked her what she had learned. She said truthfully: "I can tell by looking at the map that I will be the master of this world!"
The PC is so cowardly to build a country on her territory!
Zhang Yang was thinking about how to get back everything that belonged to her.
Kill all the PCs one by one?
This method requires too much work, and the PC will be refreshed. She will not be able to finish it in a lifetime. Zhang Yang remembered that it didn’t take long for the human observation samples to retire in their homes. The solution was definitely not to kill them all. Furthermore, since the home branch is so large, there must be some moving PCs as embellishments to add a bit of popularity.
Zhang Yang was the first to reject this idea.
The safest way was to run the mission honestly. She planned to explore Shen Zhi and trigger the next mission as soon as possible.
Alas, Shen Zhi is so disappointing!
The brain is not very good. Jianxing and Tianbian have to choose one from the other. This guy can accurately choose the wrong direction and issue tasks.
Zhang Yang disliked Shen Zhi in his heart.
Little did he know how shocked her words were to the woman. The latter tried to find any trace of joking on her face, but there was none. Her words were loud and clear, and her attitude was even more natural, as if she was explaining something that was natural and right.
The mysterious woman touched her palm and said, "Young man, your future life will be formidable."
